essence: A story with people you recognise. An outlined cartoon on warm paper where colleagues act out the situation and the idea happens to them.
explains_by: A character in a situation: the viewer recognises the moment before the idea is named.
Show the wrong move, then the right one, with the same people.
Speech and thought carry the inner side: bubbles say what a person thinks.
One running example the whole film returns to.
